<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~120.045 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ (molar mass 120.042 Da) matches this mass within typical instrument error, so the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
